  • Surrounding atom capable of pπ bonding (e.g., O, Cl).

  • SO₂: S has d-orbitals. Each S=O bond involves dπ-pπ bonding. There are two S=O bonds, one pπ-pπ and one dπ-pπ bond
Answer option 3, (ClO₄⁻)."
